{{Top|leg}}
'''Savant missiles''' were anti-aircraft projectile weaponry capable of being fired from the [[PLX-4 Missile Launcher]]. They were classed as "surprise attack" weapons and when fired appeared to be little more than "dumb" missiles, easily avoided by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with a few simple maneuvers. However, when launched, savant missiles "tagged" the intended target with its on-board [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system; after five seconds, the [[Missile/Legends|missile's]] guidance system activated and homed in on the target.
